verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Skyvern policy, setting, or commitment about whether customer data is used to train AI models. Self-hosting with your own LLM keys or a local model (skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-42) and placeholder-masked credentials (skyvern-docs-36) are adjacent data-control features, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
